name: Ajax Dependency
description: Provides a helper service for easy ajax dependencies.
project_description: This module is like Conditional Fields (respectively the JS Field States System) in that it allows the rendering of fields (access, value, other properties) to be dependent on the values of other fields. Contrary to the others, it relies on Ajax rather than client-side #states, so the dependent element is re-rendered server-side and its access is re-evaluated on each change. It provides a small static API (AjaxDependency::dependsOn/accessIf/contentIf) invoked from a form or hook_form_alter; there is no admin UI. It ships an ajax_dependency_example submodule with a demo form.
